lines.japanese: 僕の恋人を紹介しよう。
lines.english: Let me introduce my girlfriend.

lines.japanese: もう知ってるとは思うけれど、多面体の宝石みたいに角度ごと色を変える彼女の輝きは、どれだけ語ろうと語りつくせることはない。
lines.english: I'm sure you already know her, but like a many-faceted jewel that changes color with every angle, her brilliance could never be exhausted no matter how long I spoke of it.

lines.japanese: それが僕の恋人、渡来明日香さん。
lines.english: That is my girlfriend, Asuka Watarai.

lines.japanese: ある金曜日のこと。
lines.english: It happened one Friday.

lines.japanese: 「はい。それじゃ渡来さんには、おれから連絡しておきます。はい、じゃあ明日、アルバトロスの前で。失礼します」
lines.english: “Yes. Then I'll get in touch with Watarai myself. Right. See you tomorrow in front of the Albatross. Goodbye.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんからの映画の誘いは突然だったんだ。
lines.english: Hariu's invitation to the movies had come out of nowhere.

lines.japanese: しかもわりと夜の更けた時刻だった。
lines.english: It had also come fairly late at night.

lines.japanese: 「うーん、渡来さんに連絡しておくなんて言っちゃったけど……」
lines.english: “Hmm. I said I'd get in touch with Watarai, but...”

lines.japanese: たまたま僕はウェブ上で呟いたり呟かれたりする日課が長引いて起きていたけれど、彼女はもうベッドの上かもしれない。
lines.english: I happened to still be awake because my daily routine of posting and getting replies online had run long, but she might already be in bed.

lines.japanese: だとしたらメールを送っても、開封されるのは明日の朝以降になってしまうだろう。
lines.english: If she was, she wouldn't read an email until tomorrow morning at the earliest.

lines.japanese: なら直接電話……してもいいものだろうか。こんな遅くに。
lines.english: Then could I call her directly...? At this hour?

lines.japanese: とくに今日は、放課後から１０時くらいまで、僕の探し物が見つからないせいで書店巡りに付きあわせてしまったから、だいぶ疲れているに違いない。
lines.english: Especially after I'd kept her visiting bookstore after bookstore with me from the end of school until around ten today because I couldn't find what I was looking for. She had to be exhausted.

lines.japanese: ぐっすり眠ってたら起こしちゃうのも悪いなあ。
lines.english: I'd feel awful if I woke her from a sound sleep.

lines.japanese: でも金曜だし、もしかしたらまだ起きてるかもしれない。
lines.english: Then again, it was Friday. She might still be awake.

lines.japanese: とりあえず２～３コールだけして、それで出ないようだったらすぐに切ろうか。
lines.english: Maybe I'd let it ring two or three times, then hang up right away if she didn't answer.

lines.japanese: そんなことを考えながら、彼女の番号へ発信した。
lines.english: With that thought, I called her number.

lines.japanese: 三回で出ず、仕方ない切ろうとケータイを下げたところで声が聞こえた。
lines.english: She didn't answer after three rings. Just as I gave up and lowered my phone to hang up, I heard her voice.

lines.japanese: 『あい……もしもし、おはようございあすか』
lines.english: “Mornin’... How’s it Asuka-ing?”

lines.japanese: 「ござい、あすか……？」
lines.english: “How’s it... Asuka-ing?”

lines.japanese: 明らかに寝起きだった。渡来さんは頭が覚醒してないと、不思議な冗談を言うことがあるんだ。
lines.english: She had plainly just woken up. When Watarai's brain isn't awake yet, she sometimes makes very strange jokes.

lines.japanese: 「ごめん、寝てたよね」
lines.english: “Sorry. You were asleep, weren't you?”

lines.japanese: 僕は声を落として謝った。
lines.english: I lowered my voice and apologized.

lines.japanese: 『んやー、起きてたよ……』
lines.english: “Nuh-uh. I was awake...”

lines.japanese: 「うそ、寝てたんでしょ。疲れてるのにごめんね」
lines.english: “No, you were asleep, weren’t you? Sorry—you must be tired.”

lines.japanese: 『ん、へーき……羽田君だからがんばって起きた……』
lines.english: “M'fine... It's you, Haneda, so I tried real hard to wake up...”

lines.japanese: ごそごそと音がする。潜りこんでいた布団から抜けでたみたいだ。
lines.english: I heard rustling. It sounded as if she had crawled out from under the covers.

lines.japanese: 『さぶっ』
lines.english: “C-cold.”

lines.japanese: でもすぐまた戻ったみたいだ。
lines.english: But then she seemed to crawl right back in.

lines.japanese: 僕はしつこいと怒られるまで謝りたおして、それから針生さんに誘われた件を話した。
lines.english: I apologized until she got mad at me for being so persistent, then told her about Hariu's invitation.

lines.japanese: 『みんなで映画ねえ……』
lines.english: “A movie with everybody, huh...”

lines.japanese: しかし渡来さんの反応は明るいものではなかった。
lines.english: Watarai's response, however, was less than enthusiastic.

lines.japanese: 「あれっ、明日は映画っていう気分じゃなかった？」
lines.english: “Oh. Not in the mood for a movie tomorrow?”

lines.japanese: 『んー、映画はともかく『みんなで』の気分ではなかったかな』
lines.english: “I don't mind the movie. I guess I just wasn't in the mood for the ‘with everybody’ part.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうか。針生さんたちとは毎日学校で会ってるんだから、休みの日ぐらい二人きりが良かったかもね」
lines.english: “Oh, of course. You see Hariu and the others at school every day, so maybe you wanted the two of us to have the day off to ourselves.”

lines.japanese: 『……君、男のくせに、よくそういう恥ずかしいこと真顔で言えるね』
lines.english: “...You're a guy. How can you say something that embarrassing with a straight face?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、どうしよう、やっぱり断ろうか」
lines.english: “You're right. What should I do? Maybe I should turn him down after all.”

lines.japanese: 『まあ、いいよ。どうせ映画始まっちゃえば会話なんかないんだし、こっそり手でも繋いでれば実質二人きりみたいなもんでしょ』
lines.english: “Nah, it's fine. Nobody talks once the movie starts anyway. If we secretly hold hands, it'll practically be like we're alone, right?”

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん、女の子なのに、よくそういう恥ずかしいこと真顔で言えるね」
lines.english: “You're a girl. How can you say something that embarrassing with a straight face?”

lines.japanese: 『でー？　針生先輩の観たいのって？』
lines.english: “Sooo? What does Hariu wanna see?”

lines.japanese: 「あの、ほら、最近ＣＭでよくやってる『子宮を正視する日』ってやつ」
lines.english: “You know, that one they’ve been advertising nonstop. *The Day the Womb Stood Still*.”

lines.japanese: 『アメリカ映画？』
lines.english: “An American movie?”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの鼻で笑う音が聞こえた。
lines.english: I heard Watarai snort.

lines.japanese: 『からかわれてんじゃないの？　あのひと、そういう健全な大衆娯楽に足運ぶようなタマじゃないでしょ』
lines.english: “Is he messing with you? He doesn't strike me as the kind of guy who'd go see wholesome mass entertainment.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、ストーリーはどうでもいいらしいんだけど、ナントカっていう技術をナントカっていう凄いひとが担当してるから、そのひとのナントカっぷりを大スクリーンでナントカしたいんだって」
lines.english: “Yeah, he apparently doesn’t care about the story. But some amazing what’s-his-name is handling the whatchamacallit, and he wants to see the guy’s whatever-it-is on the big screen, or something.”

lines.japanese: 『そんなもん一人でナントカしろって言ってやりなよ』
lines.english: “Tell him to go do whatever it is by himself.”

lines.japanese: 「でも針生さんは、僕の感想も聞きたいんだって。自分とは違うエクストリームな意見が飛びだすはずだからって」
lines.english: “But Hariu says he wants to hear what I think. He thinks I'll come out with some extreme opinion completely different from his.”

lines.japanese: 『なるほど。そんで、どうせならエクストリームな彼女も連れてこいと』
lines.english: “I see. And if he's at it, he may as well bring the extreme girlfriend too.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん。針生さんは、カッコつけの渡来さんだとウケ狙いのコメントしかしないから、誘わなくていいって言ったんだけど」
lines.english: “No. Hariu said you put on such a cool act that you'd only make comments for laughs, so I didn't have to invite you.”

lines.japanese: 『なんだと。おい彼氏、ちゃんと言いかえしたか』
lines.english: “He said what? Hey, boyfriend. You damn well talked back, right?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、言ったよ。その通りだけど誘わないわけにはいきませんって」
lines.english: “Of course. I told him he was right, but that didn't mean I could leave you out.”

lines.japanese: 『違う。言いかえすのはそこじゃない』
lines.english: “Wrong. That isn't the part you're supposed to talk back to.”

lines.japanese: 「あと山科さんも誘いましょうって言ったんだけど、厄介なテンションの日だったら取り返しつかなくなるから呼ぶなって」
lines.english: “I suggested inviting Yamashina too, but he said if she was in one of her troublesome moods, there'd be no taking it back, so I shouldn't.”

lines.japanese: 『あのやろう、うちのタカシを独占するつもりだったな』
lines.english: “That bastard. He was planning to keep my Takashi all to himself.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだよね、せっかくだからみんなで観た方が面白いよね」
lines.english: “Exactly. If we're going anyway, it'll be more fun with everybody.”

lines.japanese: 『分かった。山科には私から連絡しとく』
lines.english: “All right. I'll call Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう。じゃあ明日１１時にアルバトロスの前だから」
lines.english: “Thanks. Then we'll meet in front of the Albatross tomorrow at eleven.”

lines.japanese: 『あい』
lines.english: “'Kay.”

lines.japanese: 「二人でこっそり手つないで観ようね」
lines.english: “We'll secretly hold hands while we watch it.”

lines.japanese: 『げ……私はさっきそんな恥ずかしいことを口にしたのか……』
lines.english: “Urgh... Did I really say something that embarrassing a minute ago...?”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは砂を吐くような声で呻いていた。
lines.english: Watarai groaned as though she had swallowed a mouthful of sand.

lines.japanese: 次の日。
lines.english: The next day.

lines.japanese: 集合時刻の十分前に指定場所へ着くと、もう渡来さんと山科さんが待っていた。
lines.english: I reached the appointed place ten minutes early, but Watarai and Yamashina were already waiting.

lines.japanese: 「お、来た来た。はよーっす」
lines.english: “Oh, there he is. Mornin'!”

lines.japanese: 休日の午前、若者たちで溢れかえった待ち合わせのメッカに、僕を歓迎してふたつの笑顔が咲く。
lines.english: On a weekend morning, amid the throngs of young people at this mecca for meeting up, two smiles bloomed to welcome me.

lines.japanese: よくよく考えれば、それはとんでもなく幸せなことだ。
lines.english: When I stopped to think about it, that was an incredible blessing.

lines.japanese: かつては夢にも見なかった、ごく普通の──あるいは普通以上の──映画みたいな青春。
lines.english: The sort of youth you saw in movies: perfectly ordinary—or perhaps better than ordinary—and something I'd once never even dreamed of having.

lines.japanese: 「おはよう。二人とも早いね」
lines.english: “Good morning. You're both early.”

lines.japanese: 「私もいま来たとこだよ。山科は一時間前からいたらしいけど」
lines.english: “I just got here too. Apparently Yamashina's been here for an hour.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、そんなに？」
lines.english: “What? That long?”

lines.japanese: 視線が集まると、山科さんは言い訳するみたいに首を振った。
lines.english: When all eyes turned to her, Yamashina shook her head as if making an excuse.

lines.japanese: 「だって、せっかく誘ってもらったのに、遅刻して迷惑かけるわけにはいかないもん」
lines.english: “You went to the trouble of inviting me. I couldn't be late and cause trouble for everyone.”

lines.japanese: 「だから大袈裟なんだって。そんな構えられちゃったら、今後軽い気持ちで誘えなくなるじゃん」
lines.english: “That's what I mean by making a big deal out of it. If you get that worked up, I won't be able to invite you casually next time.”

lines.japanese: 「逆だよ、そっちこそ気にしないで。私、誰かを待ってる時間って嫌いじゃないから」
lines.english: “It's the opposite. You don't need to worry. I don't dislike the time I spend waiting for someone.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなの？」
lines.english: “You don't?”

lines.japanese: 「目を閉じてね、自分を座標上の中心点に見立てるの。そこへ向かって、別の点や点が分刻みで接近してくるっていう図、考えてみると結構わくわくするよ。おすすめ」
lines.english: “I close my eyes and imagine myself as the central point on a coordinate plane. Then I picture other points approaching me minute by minute. It's surprisingly exciting when you think about it. I recommend it.”

lines.japanese: 「何それ、地球防衛軍？」
lines.english: “What is that, Earth Defense Force?”

lines.japanese: 「フライトシミュレーター？」
lines.english: “A flight simulator?”

lines.japanese: 「ん……ユークリッド幾何学、かな」
lines.english: “Hmm... Euclidean geometry, I suppose.”

lines.japanese: 山科さんが瞳だけで微笑んだ。なにか知的なオチを付けたみたいだ。さっぱり分からなかったけれど。
lines.english: Yamashina smiled with her eyes alone. She seemed to have supplied some intellectual punch line. I didn't understand it at all.

lines.japanese: 「あはは、山科らしい」
lines.english: “Ahaha. That's so Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　渡来さん、意味わかるの？」
lines.english: “Huh? Watarai, you understood that?”

lines.japanese: 「や、意味わかんないとこが山科らしいじゃん」
lines.english: “No. Not understanding it is what's so Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、ほんとだ」
lines.english: “Oh. You're right.”

lines.japanese: 「でしょ？」
lines.english: “See?”

lines.japanese: みんなで笑う。僕はこんな空気が大好きだ。
lines.english: We all laughed. I loved an atmosphere like this.

lines.japanese: 「山科さん、今日は体調よさそうで良かった」
lines.english: “I'm glad you're feeling well today, Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう。でも映画ぐらいでそんな気を使ってくれなくて大丈夫だよ」
lines.english: “Thank you. But you don't have to be so considerate over a movie.”

lines.japanese: 「途中もしかしたら物語の筋とは無関係に涙こぼしてるかもしれないけど、ちょっとした発作みたいなものだから気にしないで」
lines.english: “I might start crying partway through for reasons completely unrelated to the story, but think of it as a minor fit and don't worry.”

lines.japanese: 「相変わらず山科の冗談は、笑っていいやら悪いやら判断しかねるなあ」
lines.english: “As ever, I can't decide whether it's all right to laugh at Yamashina's jokes.”

lines.japanese: 「失笑すればいいと思うよ」
lines.english: “An awkward little chuckle should do.”

lines.japanese: 「おやおや、これは皆さんお揃いで。御機嫌いかがァ？　ファッキンエブリバディ」
lines.english: “Well, well. The gang's all here. How the hell are ya? Fuckin' everybody.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんが集合時刻きっかりに現れた。プラスマイナス一分の誤差もないところが彼らしい。
lines.english: Hariu appeared at the precise meeting time. Not even a minute early or late. That was very like him.

lines.japanese: 「てか、自分で招集かけといて、なんでこんなに偉そうなんだこのひと」
lines.english: “Hold on. You called everybody here, so why are you acting so high and mighty?”

lines.japanese: 「俺が呼んだのはそこのチェリーボーイだけだよ。お嬢さんたちはお気に召さなければお帰りあそばせ」
lines.english: “The only person I invited was that cherry boy. If the young ladies aren't pleased, they're most welcome to go home.”

lines.japanese: 「うわ、小学生の理論」
lines.english: “Wow. Elementary-school logic.”

lines.japanese: そして僕は、いつまで彼にチェリーと呼ばれるんだろう。たぶんずっとだ。
lines.english: And how long was he going to keep calling me Cherry? Probably forever.

lines.japanese: そんなことより、僕は恋人をかばわなければならない。昨夜も乞われたパートナーとしての務めだ。
lines.english: More importantly, I had to stand up for my girlfriend. She had asked me to do my part last night, too.

lines.japanese: 「ええと、針生さん。渡来さんが帰るなら、おれも帰りますけど……」
lines.english: “Um, Hariu. If Watarai goes home, then I'm going home too...”

lines.japanese: 「言いかえした」
lines.english: “He talked back.”

lines.japanese: 「はン、忠実な騎士殿だ。王女様のしつけが行きとどいてるねェ」
lines.english: “Hah! What a faithful knight. Her Highness has trained you well.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなのしてない。そもそもうちは亭主関白だし」
lines.english: “I haven't trained him. Besides, my husband's the boss at home.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「亭主、寝耳に水って顔してるよ」
lines.english: “Your husband looks like that's news to him.”

lines.japanese: 「おい亭主。ちょっと校舎裏来い」
lines.english: “Hey, husband. Behind the school. Now.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや違うよ、ごめんね渡来さん」
lines.english: “Oh, no, that's not it. Sorry, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「亭主、怯えてるよ」
lines.english: “Your husband looks terrified.”

lines.japanese: 「完全にカカア天下じゃねえか」
lines.english: “She's completely got you whipped.”

lines.japanese: 「違うんですよ。こう見えて渡来さんって根は謙虚だし、甘えたがりなところもあるんです」
lines.english: “That's not true. Watarai may not look it, but she's modest deep down, and she can be a little needy too.”

lines.japanese: 「う、嘘ゆうな、そんなことない。私ちょお鬼嫁」
lines.english: “D-don't lie! Nothin' like that! I'm one scary-ass wife!”

lines.japanese: 「女房、照れてるよ」
lines.english: “The wife's blushing.”

lines.japanese: 「ね、意外と可愛いでしょ」
lines.english: “See? She's surprisingly cute.”

lines.japanese: 「だから！　なんで君は人前でそういう馬鹿ップルみたいなこと言うかなあ！」
lines.english: “That's enough! Why do you always say all that lovey-dovey idiot stuff in front of people?!”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、ごめんね渡来さん」
lines.english: “Ahaha. Sorry, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「完全に馬鹿ップルじゃねえか」
lines.english: “You two are absolutely lovey-dovey idiots.”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿ップルじゃないっ！　ぺっ、ぺっ！　見ろ、彼氏に唾とか吐きちらしてやる。ぺぺぺぺぺ」
lines.english: “We are not! Ptooey! Ptooey! Look, I'm spitting all over my boyfriend. Ptooey ptooey ptooey ptooey!”

lines.japanese: 「おまえ結局、自分をどういう設定にしたいんだよ」
lines.english: “What character are you even trying to play?”

lines.japanese: 「とりあえず、二人の関係がいいバランスで保たれてることは分かった」
lines.english: “Well, at least I can see you two balance each other out.”

lines.japanese: そのあと僕らは、エレベーターでアルバトロス７階のシアターへのぼった。
lines.english: After that, we rode the elevator up to the theater on the Albatross's seventh floor.

lines.japanese: 券売所の前で四人、輪になる。チケット四枚をまとめて買ってくる代表者の選出だ。
lines.english: The four of us formed a circle in front of the box office. We had to choose a representative to buy all four tickets.

lines.japanese: 「せえの……じゃんけんぽん！」
lines.english: “Ready... Rock, paper, scissors!”

lines.japanese: 輪の中央に向けて、みんな一斉に右手を突きだした。
lines.english: We all thrust our right hands toward the center of the circle at once.

lines.japanese: けれど針生さんだけは違う。首をやや右へ傾け、左ほほの脇にそっと二本指を添えている。彼のじゃんけんはとてもロックで格好よかった。
lines.english: Except Hariu. He tilted his head slightly right and delicately placed two fingers beside his left cheek. His take on rock-paper-scissors was very rock-and-roll. Very cool.

lines.japanese: 「おっさん見にくい」
lines.english: “We can’t see your hand, old man.”

lines.japanese: でも不評だった。
lines.english: But it was poorly received.

lines.japanese: 「なにそれ、チョキ？」
lines.english: “What's that supposed to be, scissors?”

lines.japanese: 一方、針生さん以外は全員グーだった。
lines.english: Everyone except Hariu had thrown rock.

lines.japanese: 「……ファック」
lines.english: “...Fuck.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ針生さん、お願いします」
lines.english: “Then we'll leave it to you, Hariu.”

lines.japanese: 僕らは購入係に代金を渡した。
lines.english: We handed our money to the purchasing agent.

lines.japanese: 「フゥー……俺にはおまえらが気の毒でならないよ。だってそうだろう。確率論を持ちだすまでもなく、幸運の女神がヒトの子に微笑む回数なんてのは限られてンだ」
lines.english: “Phew... I can't help but feel sorry for all of you. Just think about it. You don't need probability theory to know the Goddess of Fortune can smile upon a mortal only so many times.”

lines.japanese: 「いずれおまえらの身にも、生死を賭した運だめしの機会が一度は訪れる。それは百年後かもしれないし、百秒後かもしれない。なんにせよそのときおまえらは死の淵で、今日の勝利を悔やむことになるだろうよ」
lines.english: “Sooner or later, each of you will have to gamble with your life. It may come a hundred years from now or a hundred seconds from now. Whenever it does, there at the brink of death, you'll regret today's victory.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんは哀れみの目で僕らを一瞥してから、カウンターへ向かった。
lines.english: Hariu cast us a pitying glance, then headed for the counter.

lines.japanese: 「針生さんって、重度の負けず嫌いだったんだ」
lines.english: “I never knew Hariu was such a sore loser.”

lines.japanese: 「負けの少ない人生を歩んできてるからね。耐性ないんじゃない？」
lines.english: “He's led a life without many losses. I guess he never built up a tolerance.”

lines.japanese: 「やれやれ、おめでたいことだ。今日の勝利が明日の絶望とも知らずに！」
lines.english: “Dear me, what blessed fools. Little do they know that today's triumph is tomorrow's despair!”

lines.japanese: 針生さんはこちらに背を向けたまま、こちらに聞こえるような声で唱えていた。
lines.english: With his back still turned, Hariu intoned loudly enough for us to hear.

lines.japanese: 彼は負け惜しみまでもがロックだった。
lines.english: Even his sour grapes were rock-and-roll.

lines.japanese: 「あ、針生さんお帰りなさい」
lines.english: “Oh, welcome back, Hariu.”

lines.japanese: 「はン！　お待たせいたしました、未来なき勝者の皆さん。死出の乗車券をどうぞォ」
lines.english: “Hah! Sorry to keep you waiting, winners with no future. Here are your tickets to the afterlife.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんは売り場から戻ってくるなり、四枚のチケットを押しつけるように配った。
lines.english: The moment Hariu returned from the counter, he practically shoved the four tickets at us.

lines.japanese: 「おれの席はＦ列の……２１番か。みんなは何番？」
lines.english: “My seat is row F... number twenty-one. What does everyone else have?”
“I'm twenty-two.”

lines.japanese: 僕と渡来さんは２１と２４……端同士だ。ゆうべ電話で交わした密約が果たせないのは残念だけど、くじ引きみたいなものだから仕方ない。
lines.english: Watarai and I had twenty-one and twenty-four... opposite ends. It was a shame that we couldn't fulfill the secret pact we'd made on the phone last night, but it was the luck of the draw.

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん、私と交換しよ」
lines.english: “Watarai, trade with me.”

lines.japanese: 「え、なんで。いんじゃない、このままで」
lines.english: “Huh? Why? It's fine like this.”

lines.japanese: 「白々しい。どうせ馬鹿ップル同士並んで、闇の中お手々つなぎましょうとか企んでたンだろ」
lines.english: “Yeah, right. You were plotting to sit together like lovey-dovey idiots and hold hands in the dark.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「亭主、なんでバレたのって顔してるよ」
lines.english: “Your husband looks like he's wondering how you knew.”

lines.japanese: 「まさか。うちら付きあってるっても、わりと淡泊だもん。そんな年がら年中ベタベタしたいってカンジじゃないよ。ねえ？」
lines.english: “As if. We may be dating, but we're pretty hands-off. It's not like we want to cling to each other every second of the day. Right?”

lines.japanese: 「うーん……」
「亭主、同意しかねてるよ」
lines.english: “Your husband seems unable to agree.”

lines.japanese: 「だって、せっかく換わろうって言ってくれてるんだから、べつに──」
lines.english: “She went to the trouble of offering, so there's no reason we can't—”

lines.japanese: 「べつに、いらないよね？」
lines.english: “There is no reason we need to. Right?”
“Huh...? Oh. Right...”

lines.japanese: 有無を言わせない瞳に、思わず頷いてしまった。
lines.english: Her eyes permitted no argument, and I found myself nodding.

lines.japanese: よくよく考えれば、対外的にストイックでありたがる恥ずかしがり屋の彼女なら当然の心変わりだ。
lines.english: When I stopped to think about it, this change of heart was only natural for a shy girl who wanted to appear stoic in public.

lines.japanese: どうして僕はいつも、その「よく考えれば」を瞬時にこなせないんだろう。
lines.english: Why was I never able to do that ‘stopping to think’ in the moment?

lines.japanese: 親切な森里君や高内さんがわざわざ指摘してくれるのだけど、どうやら僕は、おそろしく空気の読めないやつらしい。
lines.english: Kind Morisato and Takauchi went out of their way to tell me, but apparently I was terrifyingly bad at reading the room.

lines.japanese: 気を付けてはいるのだけど、自覚すらないせいで、つい誰かに不快な思いをさせてしまうことがある。
lines.english: I tried to be careful, but because I wasn't even conscious of it, I sometimes made people uncomfortable without meaning to.

lines.japanese: 羽田君だからいいよ、なんて優しいことを言ってくれるひとたちもいるけれど、笑って許されているうちに成長しなければと思う。
lines.english: Some people kindly told me, ‘It's all right because it's you, Haneda,’ but I knew I had to grow while they could still laugh and forgive me.

lines.japanese: 「羽田君ー？　背筋伸ばしなー？」
lines.english: “Hanedaaa? Straighten your baaack.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、うん」
lines.english: “Oh. Right.”

lines.japanese: 低い声で注意された。
lines.english: She warned me in a low voice.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんね」
lines.english: “Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「無闇に謝らない」
lines.english: “Don't apologize for everything.”

lines.japanese: 「あ……そうだね」
lines.english: “Oh... You're right.”

lines.japanese: それも最近よく彼女に注意されることだった。
lines.english: That was another thing she had often warned me about lately.

lines.japanese: 僕はあまりにも彼女の理想に遠くて自己嫌悪に陥ってしまう。
lines.english: I was so far from her ideal that I fell into self-loathing.

lines.japanese: 「おい、亭主しょんぼりしてンぞ」
lines.english: “Hey, your husband's looking dejected.”

lines.japanese: 「してないよ。してないよね？」
lines.english: “No, he's not. You're not, right?”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんはちょっと不機嫌そうだった。
lines.english: Watarai looked a little displeased.

lines.japanese: 「うん、してないよ。あはは」
lines.english: “No, I'm not. Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: 僕は彼女が怒らなくて済むよう、明るく笑ってみせた。
lines.english: I gave her a bright laugh so she wouldn't have to be angry.

lines.japanese: 「ね？　時間まだ大丈夫だよね」
lines.english: “Hey? We still have time, don't we?”

lines.japanese: 不意に山科さんが言った。時計を見ると、次の上映開始までは一時間弱ある。
lines.english: Yamashina spoke without warning. I checked the clock. The next screening was a little less than an hour away.

lines.japanese: 「私ちょっと下でパワーストーン見てくる。座席集合でいいでしょ？」
lines.english: “I'm going downstairs to look at power stones. We can meet at our seats, right?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、だったら付きあうよ。ねえ？　みんなで一緒に……」
lines.english: “Oh, then I'll come with you. Why don't we all go together...?”

lines.japanese: 「ンーじゃ俺は、上でパワーショベル見てくるわ。またあとでな」
lines.english: “Mmm, I'll go upstairs and look at power shovels. See you later.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、ちょっと待ってください針生さ……ああ、山科さんも……！」
lines.english: “What? Wait, Hari— Oh, Yamashina too...!”

lines.japanese: 「したら私も、どっかでパワードスーツ見てくる。じゃあね」
lines.english: “Then I'll go find a powered suit somewhere. Later.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ、渡来さんも？」
lines.english: “What? You too, Watarai?”

lines.japanese: 三人がそれぞれ三方に散ってゆく。僕は──
lines.english: The three of them scattered in three different directions. I—

lines.japanese: 「待って、一緒に行く」
lines.english: “Wait. I'm coming with you.”

lines.japanese: ──迷わず渡来さんのあとを追った。
lines.english: —followed Watarai without hesitation.

lines.japanese: 彼女は一瞬だけちらりと振りかえったけど、目が合わないうちにまた向きなおって、ひとりでずんずん先へ進んでいった。
lines.english: She glanced back for a split second, but turned away again before our eyes could meet and marched ahead alone.

lines.japanese: ひょっとして僕は、また選択肢を間違えたのだろうか。渡来さんはひとりになりたかったのかもしれない。付いてゆくべきは針生さんか山科さんの背中だったのか。
lines.english: Had I chosen wrong again? Maybe Watarai had wanted to be alone. Perhaps I should have followed Hariu or Yamashina instead.

lines.japanese: けれども彼女をひとりにはしたくなくて、僕は引きかえさず、黙って三歩あとを付いていった。
lines.english: But I didn't want to leave her by herself, so I didn't turn back. I followed in silence, three paces behind.

lines.japanese: 僕らのあいだに沈黙が横たわることはそう珍しくもない。ときには共に過ごしながら、ただ何十分も静寂を愉しんだりさえする。
lines.english: It wasn't unusual for silence to settle between us. Sometimes we could be together for minutes on end, simply enjoying the quiet.

lines.japanese: お互いの確認に、必ずしも多くの言葉は要さない。元来ふたりとも空白は嫌いじゃないんだ。
lines.english: We didn't always need many words to assure ourselves of each other. Neither of us had ever disliked empty space.

lines.japanese: 彼女の足が止まったのはエレベーターホール。下りの呼びボタンを押して、ドアの前で待っている。
lines.english: Her feet stopped at the elevator lobby. She pressed the down button and waited in front of the doors.

lines.japanese: 僕はほっとした。本当に付いてきてほしくないとき、彼女はさっさと化粧室へ飛びこむ。鈍感な僕でもそのぐらいの学習はしていた。
lines.english: I felt relieved. When she truly didn't want me following her, she hurried straight into the restroom. Even I, insensitive as I was, had learned that much.

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの隣りにそっと並んだ。何度かわざとらしく横顔を窺ってみたけど、彼女はまっすぐ階床表示を見上げていて、こちらをちらりとも見返して来なかった。
lines.english: I quietly took my place beside her. I made an exaggerated show of peeking at her profile several times, but she kept her eyes fixed on the floor display and never once glanced back.

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん」
lines.english: “Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「んー？」
lines.english: “Hmm?”

lines.japanese: 「どこ行くの」
lines.english: “Where are you going?”

lines.japanese: 「考えてない」
lines.english: “Haven't decided.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: たぶん彼女はいま、強張った表情を笑顔へ戻すためのきっかけを探している。
lines.english: She was probably looking for something that would let her relax her stiff expression back into a smile.

lines.japanese: こういうとき気の利いた話題転換ができない僕には、恋人のそんな子供じみた一面を愛らしく思いながら、ただ時間まかせに待っていることしかできない。
lines.english: At times like this, I wasn't clever enough to change the subject gracefully. All I could do was find that childish side of my girlfriend adorable and leave the rest to time.

lines.japanese: けれど沈黙を苦としない僕らには、結局のところそれが一番の解決策なんだと思う。
lines.english: But since neither of us found silence painful, I thought that might ultimately be the best solution.

lines.japanese: やがて昇降機の到着音が鳴って、ドアが中央から割れた。
lines.english: At last the elevator chimed its arrival and the doors parted down the middle.

lines.japanese: かご室の突き当たりまで進む渡来さん。僕はドアのすぐ脇、操作盤の前に立つ。他に乗りこんでくる客はいなかった。
lines.english: Watarai walked to the back of the car. I stood just inside the doors, in front of the control panel. No other passengers got on.

lines.japanese: 首を少しだけ後ろへ曲げて訊いてみる。
lines.english: I turned my head back a little and asked her.

lines.japanese: 「何階？」
lines.english: “What floor?”

lines.japanese: 「んー、任せる」
lines.english: “Hmm. Up to you.”

lines.japanese: 「適当だね」
lines.english: “That's pretty random.”

lines.japanese: いくぶん声が柔らかかった気がして、僕はくすりと笑いながら一階のボタンを押した。理由はない。もしかしたら意識下で、少しでも長く二人きりの密閉空間に留まりたいと思っていたのかもしれない。
lines.english: Her voice seemed a little softer, and I pressed the button for the first floor with a quiet laugh. I had no reason. Perhaps somewhere beneath awareness, I wanted to remain alone with her in that enclosed space for as long as possible.

lines.japanese: けっきょく相乗りする者の現れないままエレベーターは口を閉ざし、僕たちは静かに呑みこまれた。
lines.english: In the end, nobody joined us. The elevator closed its mouth and quietly swallowed us.

lines.japanese: ショッピングビルの喧騒が遮断され、小さな密室がぬるりと落ちはじめる。
lines.english: Cut off from the noise of the shopping center, the little sealed room began its smooth descent.

lines.japanese: エレベーターのかすかな駆動音を聞きながら、僕は背中で彼女の存在を意識した。すぐ後ろに大好きなひとがいる。適度な緊張と、絶対の安心感。
lines.english: As I listened to the elevator's faint machinery, I felt her presence at my back. The person I loved was right behind me. A pleasant tension, and a feeling of absolute security.

lines.japanese: ふと呼吸の合間に、とげのない甘い芳香が鼻孔へ忍びこんだ。先週買ってた香水だろうか。
lines.english: Between one breath and the next, a gentle, sweet fragrance slipped into my nostrils. Was it the perfume she'd bought last week?

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん、いい匂いするね」
lines.english: “You smell nice, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 振りかえらないまま、思ったことを捻りもなく口にしていた。
lines.english: Without turning around, I simply said what had come to mind.

lines.japanese: ほとんど独り言のつもりだったけど、意外にもノータイムで返答があった。
lines.english: I'd meant it almost as a remark to myself, but to my surprise, she answered at once.

lines.japanese: 「分けてあげようか？」
lines.english: “Want me to share?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「レモンライム」
lines.english: “Lemon-lime.”

lines.japanese: こっ、と靴音がひとつして、僕の体は後ろから抱きすくめられていた。
lines.english: One shoe clicked, and then two arms wrapped around me from behind.

lines.japanese: 背に押しつけられる、コート越しの感触。不意打ちのような愛情表現は、僕の胸をひどく高鳴らせた。
lines.english: I felt her through our coats, pressed against my back. The surprise show of affection made my heart pound terribly fast.

lines.japanese: 「どうよ」
lines.english: “How's that?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、うん、はは……」
lines.english: “Oh. Yeah. Haha...”

lines.japanese: 戸惑うぐらいの高揚感が僕の舌を絡ませた。
lines.english: The bewildering rush of excitement tied my tongue.

lines.japanese: 「い、いいと思う。ありがとう」
lines.english: “I-I like it. Thank you.”

lines.japanese: 「んー？　何ときめいてんだ今更」
lines.english: “Hmm? What's got your heart racing after all this time?”

lines.japanese: ぐいぐい締めつけながら、渡来さんは冷静ぶった声で言う。
lines.english: Watarai squeezed me tighter and spoke in a voice of feigned composure.

lines.japanese: 「だって、いきなりだから驚いて……今日はそういう気分じゃないのかと思った」
lines.english: “It was so sudden that it surprised me... I thought you weren't in the mood for this today.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね。ちょっと気が変わっちゃった」
lines.english: “I wasn't. Then I changed my mind.”

lines.japanese: そう言って彼女は、気が変わる前の──ゆうべの約束を守るように、僕の手と自分の手とを繋ぎあわせた。
lines.english: With that, she joined her hand with mine, as if honoring last night's promise from before her mind had changed.

lines.japanese: 「ごめん。なんかみんなの前だと、ついカッコ付けたくなっちゃって」
lines.english: “Sorry. In front of everybody, I can't help wanting to look cool.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、分かるよ。うん、分かる。こっちこそすぐ合わせられなくてごめん」
lines.english: “No, I understand. I do. I'm sorry I couldn't keep up right away.”
“Oh, no...”

lines.japanese: また謝ってしまった。
lines.english: I had apologized again.

lines.japanese: だけど渡来さんはそんなことを咎めたりはせず、握った手を愛おしげに弄びながらくすりと笑った。
lines.english: But Watarai didn't reproach me. She gave a quiet laugh and lovingly toyed with the hand she held.

lines.japanese: 「面倒な女だと思ったでしょ」
lines.english: “You thought I was a high-maintenance woman, didn't you?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、そんなの前からだよ」
lines.english: “No. You've always been like that.”
“Oof. Sharp tongue...”

lines.japanese: 「そうかな。じゃあ渡来さんと同じだね」
lines.english: “You think so? Then I'm just like you.”

lines.japanese: 「また毒舌……でも反論できない」
lines.english: “There it is again... But I can't argue.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは」
lines.english: “Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: 似てないようで似ている僕らは、恋人たちの距離で微笑みを交換した。
lines.english: We were alike where we seemed unlike, and we exchanged smiles across the intimate distance between lovers.

lines.japanese: 「やっぱり山科と席換えてもらえば良かったかなぁ」
lines.english: “Maybe I should've traded seats with Yamashina after all.”

lines.japanese: 恋する乙女の声で彼女が甘える。僕は誘惑されかけながらもきっぱり断った。
lines.english: She pleaded in the voice of a girl in love. I was nearly tempted, but firmly refused.

lines.japanese: 「だめだよ、みんなの前ではカッコ付けなきゃ」
lines.english: “You can't. You have to look cool in front of everyone.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、分かった……」
lines.english: “All right. I understand...”

lines.japanese: 彼女は恨めしそうに額をぶつけてきた。
lines.english: She bumped her forehead against me resentfully.

lines.japanese: 「怒った？」
lines.english: “Are you mad?”

lines.japanese: 「んーん」
lines.english: “Mm-mm.”

lines.japanese: 「彼氏の言うことは絶対でしょ。うちは亭主関白だからね」
lines.english: “My boyfriend’s word is law, right? He’s the boss in this relationship.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「えじゃねえよ」
lines.english: “Don't ‘what’ me.”

lines.japanese: 締めつけが厳しくなった。痛いよ渡来さんと言って困ったふりをする。
lines.english: Her grip tightened. I pretended to be distressed and told her she was hurting me.

lines.japanese: こんな定番のやりとりを繰りかえすごとに、ふたりの仲はゆっくり深まってゆくのだと思う。
lines.english: I imagined that with every repetition of this familiar routine, our bond slowly deepened.

lines.japanese: 「僕だってカッコ付けたいからね。本当はすごく残念なんだ」
lines.english: “I want to look cool too, you know. The truth is, I'm terribly disappointed.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ今晩うち泊ってきなよ」
lines.english: “Then spend the night at my place.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　うーん、でも……」
lines.english: “What? Hmm, but...”

lines.japanese: 「旦那の言うこと何でも聞いてあげちゃうぜ？」
lines.english: “I'll do anything my husband tells me.”

lines.japanese: かすれた囁き声が耳へ忍びこんできた。
lines.english: Her husky whisper slipped into my ear.

lines.japanese: 僕は一瞬で陥落した。
lines.english: I surrendered in an instant.

lines.japanese: 「うん、じゃあ、そうさせてもら──」
lines.english: “All right, then. I'd be happy to—”

lines.japanese: とつぜん僕の体は突きとばされた。
lines.english: Without warning, she shoved me away.

lines.japanese: 夢から覚めたみたいに呆然としていたら、ドアが開いて大勢の買い物客たちと対面した。
lines.english: As I stood dazed, as though wrenched from a dream, the doors opened and I found myself facing a crowd of shoppers.

lines.japanese: 「行くよー、ぼけっとすんなー」
lines.english: “Come on. Quit standing there like an idiot.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんはひとりでさっさと降りていった。
lines.english: Watarai strode out on her own.

lines.japanese: 誰もが目を瞠るような凛とした美しさを従え、風を切るように颯爽と歩いてゆく。
lines.english: With the kind of dignified beauty that turned every head, she walked briskly ahead as though cutting through the wind.

lines.japanese: その姿は本当に格好がいいんだ。
lines.english: She really did look incredibly cool.

lines.japanese: たまに意地悪だけど、たまに甘えたがりな渡来さん。
lines.english: Watarai, sometimes mean and sometimes needy.

lines.japanese: 彼女が、僕の恋人。
lines.english: She was my girlfriend.
